title: Observability: ioctl error paths discard errno before returning translated code
description: What is invisible: when an ioctl fails, crypto2dev_to_wc_err(errno) is called and the errno is discarded; no WOLFSSL_MSG is emitted. A support engineer debugging WC_HW_E from wc_AesCbcEncrypt cannot distinguish pool exhaustion (fd open fail), device busy (EBUSY), algo not found (ENOENT), or FIPS degraded (EACCES) without attaching a debugger and adding printfs. Bad outcome: a production FIPS degradation (EACCES → FIPS_NOT_ALLOWED_E) is silent; the application gets an opaque error code with no log entry identifying which operation failed, which algorithm was requested, or what the original errno was. Fix: add WOLFSSL_MSG on every non-CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE error path from crypto2dev_to_wc_err that includes algo string and raw errno.
